instruction: Set the VLC media player volume to 75% (approximately 192 on the VLC scale).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC volume to 75% (192 on VLC's 0-256 scale where 256=100%). Agent can use Ctrl+Up/Down or Tools > Effects and Filters. Custom getter reads volume from VLC HTTP status.xml, metric compares with tolerance of 10.
metadata.verification: VLC volume scale: 256 = 100%, so 75% = 192. Getter extracts <volume> element from status.xml, metric checks within tolerance of ±10.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts volume from VLC HTTP status.xml interface using proper XML parsing
Metric logic appropriately uses tolerance-based comparison (±10) for volume verification, suitable for UI-based volume adjustments
Expected value of 192 accurately represents 75% on VLC's 0-256 scale (where 256=100%)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement stated in the instruction
Proper error handling: getter returns None on failure, metric checks for None and returns 0.0
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns int → metric compares int with tolerance → returns float score
State accessibility is ensured: VLC is launched with HTTP interface enabled, allowing the getter to access volume state
